onboarding.title: Welcome Guide
onboarding.description: Re-open the welcome guide to see an overview of WorkTape's features.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Advanced settings for debugging and development.

prompts.title: Periodic Work Prompts
prompts.description: WorkTape reminds you at regular intervals to log what you're working on. Set your preferred frequency — every 30 minutes is a great starting point.

sprintBoard.title: Sprint Board
sprintBoard.description: Manage your tasks on a visual Kanban board. Link work log entries to tasks to automatically track how much time you spent on each.

export.title: Data Export
export.description: Export your work log entries as CSV or JSON. Use your data for career advocacy, freelance invoicing, or reporting.

title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your WorkTape preferences and account settings.

promptFrequency.label: Prompt Frequency
promptFrequency.description: How often (in minutes) should WorkTape prompt you to log your work?
promptFrequency.validationError: Please enter a value between 1 and 1440 minutes (24 hours)

launchOnStartup.title: Launch on Startup
launchOnStartup.description: Automatically start WorkTape when you log in.

featureTips.title: Feature tips
featureTips.description: Small hints that surface when you visit a page for the first time.

updates.title: Software Updates
updates.description: Check for new versions of WorkTape.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Store full API requests (including screenshots) for debugging purposes.
debug.warningBody: Debug mode stores full API requests including base64-encoded screenshots. This will significantly increase database size (5-20MB per request with 10 screenshots).
debug.warningEstimate: With {{requests}} requests per day, expect ~{{gb}} GB per day. Old debug logs are automatically deleted after the retention period.
debug.retentionDescription: Debug logs older than this will be automatically deleted daily to prevent database bloat.
debug.retentionValidation: Retention days must be between 1 and 30
debug.cleanupSuccess: Cleaned up {{count}} old debug log entries

developerTools.title: Developer tools
developerTools.description: These actions are intended for development and testing only.
developerTools.dayEnded: Today is currently ended. Click to reopen it.
